Attendance/missed tests Policy
 The scores of your 4 best lecture quizzes would be counted towards the total. There is no further relaxation for falling ill, breaking limbs, attending family events etc. So please ensure that you do not miss more than 1 quiz.
If you miss a minor due to illness (medical certificate needed) then I will scale the marks you receive  in the other minor and major to award you marks in the missed minor. There is no reminor.
